description: Defines the DataMatrix 2D barcode class, providing constructors, encoding options, rendering logic, and validation for DataMatrix barcodes within the PdfSharp library. This class is an internal implementation specific to the PDFsharp project, used for generating DataMatrix barcodes in PDFs.

classes.name: CodeDataMatrix
classes.description: Represents a DataMatrix 2D barcode, providing methods for initialization, encoding, and rendering of the barcode.

methods.name: SetEncoding
methods.description: Sets the encoding type for the DataMatrix barcode.

methods.name: CreateEncoding
methods.description: Creates an encoding string based on the specified DataMatrixEncoding type and text length.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Handles drawing the DataMatrix barcode onto the provided graphics context, including rotation and quiet zone handling.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Validates the input text for compatibility with the DataMatrix structure.
